Although exporters are evaluating hedging options, their engagement is lackluster due to recent regulations. As Brent crude oil prices settle around $92 per barrel, experts forecast the rupee to oscillate within the bandwidth of 93.25 to 94.

articles.description: Indian equities have seen significant gains recently, with the Sensex and Nifty reaching their highest levels since February.
